Read this one line code block for **more info** on **Minwi**
```
Mnwi (pronounced /ˈmɪn.wi/) is a personification of the Minecraft Wiki. Originally created by user MuzikBike in January 2025, it was adopted as the wiki's official mascot on February 5, 2026, as the result of a forum discussion. Minwi's design is based on the colors and elements present in the Minecraft Wiki logo.

Minwi has a light tan skin. Their hair is split-dyed down the middle, with blue on the left and green on the right, representing ocean and forest respectively. Conversely, their left eye is blue and their right eye is green. They wear a wreath made of pink petals on their head and their left wrist, resembling the cherry grove biome. They also wear a cloud hairpin on the left side of their head. They are typically depicted in a white T-shirt with green stripes, under blue overalls. A bee pattern can be seen on the back of the overalls. They wear brown shoes. Minwi originated as a proposal for wiki mascot in the forum thread How about a wiki mascot?. The first Minwi design was made by MuzikBike. The final adopted design was made by QwertyLilley. It was chosen for its more pastel color palette and "vanilla" face structure.
```
